name: Tesseract
recipe: A rotating 4D hypercube (tesseract): 16 vertices in 4-space rotating through two independent 4D planes, stereographically projected to 3D then to 2D, its 32 edges drawn as glowing struts so the inner cube appears to turn inside-out through the outer one — the iconic 4D wireframe. Optionally nest a few concentric tesseracts. Default COLORFUL: edges hue-gradient by 4D depth (w-coordinate) with additive glow on dark, luminance ~0.15-0.4, fills frame, continuously rotating.
kernel: 16 tesseract vertices; each frame apply two incommensurate 4D rotations (K.t), project 4D->3D->2D (perspective), draw the 32 edges as two-pass glowing struts hued by w-depth; vertices as glowing nodes. Continuous 4D rotation = motion. Nest 1-3 scaled copies.
style: depth-glow (default, w-hued edges). Also: neon-wire, gold-chrome, blueprint (white on blue), ice.

name: Times-Table Cardioid
recipe: Modular-multiplication times-table on a circle: N points on a circle, connect each i to (i*k mod N) with a chord; the envelope of chords sweeps through cardioid, nephroid, and multi-lobed caustic curves as the multiplier k continuously increases on K.t — a mesmerizing string-envelope that morphs forever. Default COLORFUL: chords as thin additive lines hue-gradient by index forming luminous caustic envelopes on dark, luminance ~0.15-0.4, fills frame.
kernel: N points on a circle; each frame draw chords i->(i*k mod N) as thin ADD lines hued by i, k increases continuously on K.t (fractional k interpolates) so the cardioid/nephroid envelope perpetually morphs; two-pass glow. N/k from params. Continuous k-sweep = motion.
style: caustic-envelope (default, index-hued chords). Also: gold-silk, neon, blueprint (white on blue), ink (named mono).

name: Rose Window
recipe: A generative Gothic cathedral rose window: radial N-fold symmetry of nested stone tracery, foils, cusps and petal-lights filled with jewel stained-glass, backlit so the glass glows — recursively subdivided radial mullions. Slowly rotate + let the backlight brighten/drift + recolor the glass on K.section. Default COLORFUL: jewel stained-glass (ruby/sapphire/emerald/gold) in dark stone tracery, backlit glow; luminance ~0.2-0.5, fills frame, radially symmetric.
kernel: radial N-fold symmetric generative tracery (nested arcs, foils, petals via reflected/rotated units cached in S) filled with jewel glass colors + dark stone mullions; a backlight radial glow behind; slow rotation + backlight drift + recolor on K.t/section. Symmetric, fills frame.
style: cathedral (default, jewel glass + stone). Also: art-nouveau, neon-glass, mono-tracery (named), sunset-backlit.

name: Blancmange Curve
recipe: The blancmange / Takagi fractal curve: a sum of ever-finer triangle-wave layers builds a continuous nowhere-differentiable crinkly curve; render as layered parallax bands of the curve at increasing depth (a fractal mountain-fabric) that shiver as the layer phases/weights drift on K.t. Distinct from Weierstrass (triangle waves, sharper self-similar creases). Default COLORFUL: stacked translucent curve-bands in a spectral gradient on dark, luminance ~0.18-0.45, fills frame.
kernel: blancmange T(x)=sum s^n * tri(2^n x) with weights/phases drifting on K.t; draw several filled bands (curve at increasing detail depth) with spectral hue + translucency stacked back-to-front, slow horizontal scroll per layer. Shiver + scroll = motion.
style: spectral-fabric (default, stacked hue bands). Also: aurora, ink-crease (named mono), neon, thermal.

name: Dadras Attractor
recipe: The Dadras attractor: a 3D chaotic system that winds into a graceful multi-lobed swirling ribbon-knot. Rotate the projection on incommensurate K.t rates; drift a parameter so it breathes. Default COLORFUL: density+depth log-mapped through a palette (magenta->cyan->white) glowing on dark, luminance ~0.12-0.35. Accumulate 40-70k iterates/frame with bright splats so it is dense/bright.
kernel: iterate Dadras ODE (dt~.01) 40-70k/frame; rotate+project, splat bright into a density buffer shaded by z; log-map palette LUT, upscale. Two incommensurate rotation rates = motion. Dense + bright.
style: ribbon-knot (default, magenta->cyan->white). Also: plasma, ember, ice, pencil (named mono).

name: Boids Flock
recipe: FIX of a baseline asset that reads as a MONOTONE GRADIENT BLUR (the flocking isn't visible). Re-author as a clear CRAIG-REYNOLDS BOIDS flock: hundreds of distinct triangular boids that visibly cohere, align and separate into swirling murmurations, splitting and merging, wheeling as a flock (with predator-avoidance darts). Each boid a visible arrow/triangle oriented to its heading, leaving a faint motion trail. Default COLORFUL: boids hued by heading or speed (spectral flock) on a dusk-gradient sky; luminance ~0.15-0.4, clearly a swarming flock, motion 0.03+.
kernel: ~200-500 boids (pos, vel) with cohesion+alignment+separation + occasional predator; draw each as an oriented triangle/arrow hued by heading, faint trails; flock wheels and reshapes continuously. Reynolds rules, visible individuals, murmuration. Fill frame.
style: murmuration (default, heading-hued boids on dusk). Also: starling-black (on pale sky), neon-swarm, firefly, ink (named mono).

name: L-System Garden
recipe: FIX of a baseline asset that is a TINY SPARSE plant sprig in a huge empty cream field. Re-author as a LUSH L-system garden that FILLS the frame: several plants/algae/seaweed grown from different L-system rules (branching + leaves/flowers), swaying in wind on K.t (incommensurate so motion never re-phases), periodically regrowing new species. Default COLORFUL: luminous green foliage + colored flowers on a soft gradient ground, fills ~80% of frame, clearly swaying. Luminance ~0.2-0.45.
kernel: cache several L-system branch structures (different axioms/rules, seeded); each frame draw them with a cumulative K.t wind sway (tips move most, INCOMMENSURATE frequencies so it never re-phases), flowers/leaves at tips; fill the width with 3-6 plants; regrow on K.section. Bright, full, swaying.
style: garden (default, green + flowers). Also: seaweed (teal underwater), autumn, bioluminescent, ink (named mono, sumi plants on cream).

name: Fourier Epicycles
recipe: POLISH of a version that is too FAINT/DARK (lum 0.11, faint grey scribble). Keep the Fourier epicycles (chain of rotating circles whose tip traces a curve) but make it BRIGHTER and RICHER: bright glowing epicycle circles + radii, a luminous traced curve with a long glowing fade-trail, more terms so it draws intricate figures. Continuous drift so it perpetually redraws. Default COLORFUL: spectral glowing epicycle chain + bright gold traced curve on dark; luminance 0.15-0.4, fills more of the frame.
kernel: chain of N rotating epicycle circles (Fourier series of a target curve), tip traces a curve into a glowing fade-trail buffer; draw the circles/radii bright + the trail luminous; frequencies drift on K.t so it never exactly repeats. Brighter, fuller, more terms.
style: spectral-glow (default, bright chain + gold trace). Also: neon, gold, blueprint (white on blue), ink (named mono).

name: Lightning
recipe: POLISH of a version that is too FAINT/low-motion (lum 0.14, motion 0.012). Keep the dielectric-breakdown lightning but make it BRIGHTER and more DYNAMIC: multiple bright branching bolts with white-hot cores + wide colored glow (two-pass), striking FREQUENTLY (re-strike on K.t/beat) with flicker + afterglow, and a faint illuminated cloud/sky so the whole frame flashes. Motion clearly >0.03. Default COLORFUL: violet/white bolts flashing on a dim storm sky; luminance 0.12-0.35.
kernel: draw several branching bolt polylines (recursive fork) with wide dim ADD glow + bright near-white core; bolts re-strike to new paths frequently on K.t/beat with flicker + fading afterglow; faint sky-flash on strike. Brighter, more frequent, more motion.
style: storm (default, violet/white bolts + sky flash). Also: crimson, ice-blue, toxic-green, blueprint (named mono).

name: Water Caustics
recipe: POLISH of a version that is too FAINT/DARK (lum 0.10, faint teal wisps). Keep the underwater caustics but make them BRIGHTER and fuller: a luminous rippling caustic net of light filaments dancing across the whole frame (like sunlight on a pool floor), bright interweaving light-lines on a deep water-blue ground (lum 0.2-0.45), continuously flowing. Default COLORFUL: bright cyan/white caustic web on teal-indigo depths.
kernel: per-pixel caustic field (existing kernel) with HIGHER exposure so the light-net is bright + a fuller/denser caustic pattern (more overlapping ripple gradients) evolving on K.t; deep-blue water ground so it's not near-black. Bright, full, flowing.
style: pool (default, bright cyan/white net on blue). Also: deep-sea (bioluminescent), gold-sun, thermal, mono (named).

name: Isometric City
recipe: FIX of a baseline asset that is near-STATIC (motion 0.006) and a bit dark. Re-author as a living isometric city: a generative grid of isometric buildings with LIT WINDOWS that twinkle/change, moving traffic light-streaks along streets, a day-night light sweep, drifting clouds/blimps, and the city slowly scrolling or the camera panning — a breathing metropolis. Make it clearly MOVE (motion 0.02-0.1) and reasonably bright (lum 0.15-0.4). Default COLORFUL: dusk city with warm lit windows + neon signs + traffic streaks on a blue-violet iso grid.
kernel: generative isometric building grid (seeded heights) with per-window lights toggling on K.t, traffic streaks moving along streets, a slow scroll/pan + day-night tint sweep on K.t, drifting clouds. Buildings via iso boxes. Clearly moving + brighter.
style: dusk-neon (default, lit windows + neon + traffic). Also: night-cyber, blueprint (white on blue), sunset, mono (named).

name: Differential Growth
recipe: FIX of a baseline asset that is a THIN wobbly line on a huge empty cream field (sparse, low-motion). Re-author as a LUSH differential-growth organism that FILLS the frame: a closed curve that continuously subdivides and repels itself into ever-more convoluted brain-coral / intestinal / labyrinthine folds, growing to fill most of the frame then regrowing. Draw it as a thick colorful ribbon or filled folds with depth shading. Default COLORFUL: the growing convoluted ribbon in a rich gradient (coral/teal) on a toned ground (lum 0.2-0.45), clearly growing/writhing (motion 0.02+).
kernel: a polyline of nodes with attraction-to-neighbors + repulsion-from-all + edge-splitting (differential growth) in S; grows/convolutes each frame filling the frame; draw as a thick hue-gradient ribbon (or filled) with slight shading; regrow on K.section. Growth = motion. Fill the frame, colorful.
style: brain-coral (default, coral/teal ribbon). Also: intestine (pink/red), hyphae (gold on dark), contour (named mono), neon.
